async def act(page):
    """
    From the current Dashboard page, navigate to the Sales Orders grid, filter for Complete orders,
    open the first (oldest after attempted sort) order and print the billing name (first non-empty
    line after the "Bill to:" label). Uses accessibility-centric selectors.
    """
    import asyncio

    billing_name = ""
    try:
        # Navigate (relative) to the Sales Orders grid
        await page.goto("index.php/admin/sales_order/index/")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Try to set the Status filter to 'Complete' using commonly used combobox names
        status_locator = None
        for status_name in ["Status", "Order Status", "Status:"]:
            try:
                comb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=status_name)
                # Try selecting by visible label
                await comb.select_option(label="Complete")
                status_locator = comb
                break
            except Exception:
                status_locator = None
                continue

        # Click Search to apply filters. Prefer the Search button inside the same group as the status combobox
        clicked_search = False
        if status_locator is not None:
            try:
                group_with_status = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=status_locator).first
                search_btn = group_with_status.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
                await search_btn.click()
                clicked_search = True
            except Exception:
                clicked_search = False

        if not clicked_search:
            # Fallback to top-level Search-like buttons
            for name in ["Search", "Filter", "Apply Filters"]:
                try:
                    btn = page.get_by_role("button", name=name).first
                    await btn.click()
                    clicked_search = True
                    break
                except Exception:
                    continue

        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

        # Optional: try to sort by a date-like column header to try to get oldest first
        for col_name in ["Purchased On", "Order Date", "Purchased", "Created At"]:
            try:
                col = page.get_by_role("columnheader", name=col_name).first
                await col.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(200)
                await col.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
                break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Locate orders table and the first data row's order link href
        href = None
        try:
            orders_table = page.get_by_role("table").first
            first_data_row = orders_table.get_by_role("row").nth(1)
            order_link = first_data_row.get_by_role("link").first
            href = await order_link.get_attribute("href")
        except Exception:
            href = None

        if not href:
            print("")
            return

        # Navigate to the order view using the href
        await page.goto(href)
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Extract the billing name from the 'Bill to:' block
        try:
            bill_label = page.get_by_text("Bill to:").first
            billing_name = await bill_label.evaluate(
                '''node => {
                    // climb up to a containing element that includes address lines
                    let el = node
                    for (let i = 0; i < 8 && el; i++) {
                        if (el.innerText && /Bill to:/i.test(el.innerText) && el.innerText.trim().length > 8) break
                        el = el.parentElement
                    }
                    if (!el) return ''
                    let text = el.innerText.replace(/Bill to:/i, '').trim()
                    if (!text) return ''
                    let lines = text.split(/\r?
/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
                    return lines.length ? lines[0] : (text.split(/\r?
/)[0] || '').trim()
                }'''
            )
            if billing_name is None:
                billing_name = ""
        except Exception:
            billing_name = ""

    except Exception:
        billing_name = ""

    # Print the billing name for the harness to capture
    print(billing_name if billing_name is not None else "")
